name: @battuta/plugin-folder-view
description: A side panel listing the scores in a folder you opened: click to open, open tabs marked, unsaved ones starred, and the list follows the disk as it changes.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare.
./tree is exported so the panel's list model can be read by a test outside this package without reaching into src/ by path; nothing in the app imports it.
dependencies: @battuta/api and react (a panel plugin renders into a host area) and nothing else of the workspace. react-dom is NOT here: the host owns the React tree and the root.
